name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a six-file schema-11 Codex workflow with up to five execution tasks, deployment Markdown review exemptions, execution-task-owned acceptance, recoverable hub replacement, and transactional recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts a permanent project hub with up to five visible execution tasks, one per request. Authorized bootstrap and upgrade deployments write managed Markdown without draft review; ordinary document edits retain review. Supports execution-task-owned acceptance, recoverable hub replacement, and upgrades from immutable baselines.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow from a task inside the target project to apply a task-aware upgrade with current-project isolation and empty-snapshot fail-closed recovery.
